{"command": "str_replace", "path": "/memories/repo/testing-gotchas.md", "old_str": "- (2026-08-23) The CI `fallow` job has 4 sub-gates", "new_str": "- (2026-08-29) `renderers/tinymce`: real CodeMirror 6 extensions (linter/autocompletion) CAN be
  exercised in `happy-dom` with a real `EditorView`/`EditorState` (no need to hand-reimplement the
  logic in the test) — `@codemirror/lint`'s `forceLinting(view)` + `diagnosticCount`/
  `forEachDiagnostic` works synchronously-ish (await one `Promise.resolve()`); `@codemirror/
  autocomplete`'s `startCompletion(view)` is async on a ~50ms internal debounce, so poll
  `completionStatus(view.state) === "pending"` in a loop before reading `currentCompletions`.
  Discovered a real bug this way: `pantokenHtmlCompletion`'s override returned `from: pos -
  partial.length` (spanning the whole typed `instui-foo` token) — CodeMirror's own fuzzy matcher
  then filters the returned options (labels like `"button"`, with no `instui-` prefix) against
  that full span and rejects everything, so 0 completions ever showed up in real usage. Fixed by
  anchoring `from` at the last `-` boundary (or right after `instui-` with no dash yet) so the
  matched span is just the currently-typed suffix. Manually reimplementing a picker's inline logic
  in a test file (as the original tinymce tests did for `autocomplete.test.ts`/`lint.test.ts`)
